rules.objective: Match tiles from hand to exposed table tiles to capture pairs; score by pip counts and red spots; highest total wins and others pay the difference.
rules.gameplay:
1. Setup: Woodpile four tiles high; 16 tiles laid face up; each player draws hand (2 players: 12 each; 3 players: 8 each).
2. Play: On your turn match one hand tile to an exposed tile (same pip total, or the 2-1 and 4-2 tiles Gee Joon together); collect the pair. A pair of 6-6 tiles may be laid immediately. Then draw one tile from woodpile; if it matches an exposed tile, collect it; else leave it face up.
3. Matching: Identical tiles can form sets of three; fourth identical captures all.
4. Scoring: Little fish (under 8 pips): 1 point per red spot, round up to multiple of ten. Big fish (8+ pips): 2 points per pip. Highest total wins; others pay winner the difference.
keyRules: Two tiles match when their pips have the same total; the 2-1 and 4-2 tiles (Gee Joon) match together
Each turn: match one tile and collect pair, then draw one from woodpile and either collect or expose
Little fish score by red spots (round up to ten); big fish score two points per pip
Winner is highest score; others pay the difference to the winner
